title: 1 December 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles’ 60th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club took place on this day.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the Cavern typically lasted from 12-2pm. Overall this was their 89th appearance at the soon-to-be-famous cellar club on Mathew Street, including their numerous late-night shows.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows at the Mathew Street venue between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1978: Album release: Wings Greatest by Wings
  • 1972: Recording: Red Rose Speedway by Wings
  • 1972: UK single release: Hi, Hi, Hi by Wings
  • 1971: US single release: Happy Xmas (War Is Over) by John Lennon
  • 1970: Travel: John Lennon – London to New York City
  • 1969: Ringo Starr is interviewed for the BBC’s Line-Up
  • 1969: The final Beatles Book monthly magazine is published
  • 1964: Ringo Starr goes into hospital

  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Memorial Hall, Northwich
